$comment: Ashfall art manifest. The engine (index.html → loadArt) fetches this file, then every pack listed below, and loads each asset whose file exists. Anything missing falls back to the built-in canvas primitives, so packs can be delivered one asset at a time.
name: Ashfall art manifest

engine.exportScale: deliver @1x (logical px) PNG with alpha; optional @2x copies as <file>@2x.png
engine.anchor: [x,y] as fractions of the frame; [0.5,1] = bottom-centre = the character's feet / a tile's bottom edge
engine.sheet: frames laid out left→right, wrapping to a new row when the sheet is wider than frameW*cols; frame index 0 is the first
engine.style: Bold flat shapes, 2px dark outlines (#0a0e1a), saturated accents, slight rust/grime. Post-apocalyptic science + magic. Readable at 32px.
